# Rough n Tough Junk Removal LLC

> Locally owned, fully insured junk removal and hauling serving Parrish, Palmetto, Bradenton, Sarasota and Venice, Florida. Free quotes and all-in pricing starting at $125.

Rough n Tough Junk Removal is a small, owner-operated junk removal company run by Landon in the Palmetto, FL area. The crew loads, hauls and disposes of furniture, appliances, yard debris, construction debris and full property cleanouts. Every job gets a free, upfront, all-in quote that includes labor, hauling and standard disposal. It is a registered Florida LLC (#L26000485894) and fully insured.

## Key facts
- Phone: (941) 254-1023
- Email: info@roughntoughjunkremoval.com
- Service areas: Parrish, Palmetto, Bradenton, Sarasota and Venice, FL and the surrounding area
- Pricing: priced by truck volume. Minimum $125, 1/4 load $175, 1/2 load $300, 3/4 load $400, full load $500. Final price confirmed on site.
- Hours: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 8am-3pm, Sun closed
- Rating: 5.0 stars from 7 Google reviews

## How it works
1. Call, text or send a photo of what needs to go.
2. Get an upfront, all-in price before any work starts.
3. The crew does the lifting, loads it and hauls it away, usually the same visit.

## Services
- [Furniture Removal](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/furniture-removal/): Couches, mattresses, tables, dressers and more.
- [Appliance Removal](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/appliance-removal/): Washers, dryers, refrigerators, stoves and more.
- [Estate Cleanouts](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/estate-cleanouts/): Estate, foreclosure and downsizing cleanouts.
- [Yard Debris Removal](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/yard-debris-removal/): Vines, brush, storm debris and overgrown yards.
- [Hot Tub & Playground Removal](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/hot-tub-playground-removal/): Hot tubs, swing sets, trampolines and play structures.
- [Electronic Waste Removal](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/electronic-waste-removal/): TVs, monitors, computers, printers and e-waste.
- [Construction Debris Removal](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/construction-debris-removal/): Drywall, lumber, flooring, tile and remodel debris.
- [House & Garage Cleanouts](https://www.roughntoughjunkremoval.com/house-garage-cleanouts/): Whole-home, garage, attic and storage cleanouts.
